sentences.en: Hello, and welcome to Speaking of Psychology, a biweekly podcast from the American Psychological
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听《心理学对话》，这是来自美国心理学会的双周播客节目，

sentences.en: Association.
sentences.zh: Association.

sentences.en: I'm your host, Caitlin Luna.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人凯特琳·卢娜。

sentences.en: Before we get started, we want to remind you that we love hearing from our listeners.
sentences.zh: 在开始之前，我们想提醒大家，我们非常乐意倾听听众的反馈。

sentences.en: If you have any comments, questions, or ideas for us, email me at kluna at apa.org.
sentences.zh: 如果您有任何意见、问题或想法，请发邮件至 kluna@apa.org 与我联系。

sentences.en: That's K-L-U-N-A at A-P-A dot org.
sentences.zh: 也就是 K-L-U-N-A，后面是 A-P-A点org。

sentences.en: Half of Americans today say they are lonely, and the average person reports having only one close friend.
sentences.zh: 如今，有一半的美国人表示他们感到孤独，普通人则表示自己只有一个密友。

sentences.en: Loneliness can also make us sick, contributing to heart disease, depression, suicide, and cognitive decline.
sentences.zh: 孤独也会让我们生病，它会导致心脏病、抑郁症、自杀和认知能力下降。

sentences.en: Why is this happening, and what can we do about it?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？我们又能做些什么呢？

sentences.en: In this episode of Speaking of Psychology, I'm speaking with Dr. Julianne Holt-Lunstad, Professor of Psychology
sentences.zh: 在本期《心理学对话》中，我邀请到了杨百翰大学心理学与神经科学教授

sentences.en: and Neuroscience at Brigham Young University, who's an expert on loneliness and social connectedness.
sentences.zh: 朱莉安·霍尔特-伦斯塔德（Julianne Holt-Lunstad）博士，她是一位研究孤独感与社会连结的专家。
zh_words: 朱莉安·霍尔特-伦斯塔德

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Holt-Lunstad.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，霍尔特-伦斯塔德博士。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So first, I wanted to ask, do we have a loneliness epidemic, and what trends are you seeing in your research?
sentences.zh: 首先，我想问一下，我们是否正面临一场孤独流行病？你在研究中看到了哪些趋势？

sentences.en: You know, that's a great question, and I've certainly heard this term being used, epidemic.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是个很好的问题，我确实听到过“流行病”这个词被用来形容这种状况。

sentences.en: Vivek Murthy, the former U.S.
sentences.zh: 维韦克·穆尔蒂（Vivek Murthy），美国前

sentences.en: Surgeon General, has suggested that we have a loneliness epidemic.
sentences.zh: 卫生总监，曾提出我们正面临一场孤独流行病。

sentences.en: So have leaders from multiple nations.
sentences.zh: 多个国家的领导人也这么认为。

sentences.en: And even recently, I was attending a talk where someone from the World Health Organization also referred to this as an epidemic.
sentences.zh: 就在最近，我参加一个讲座时，世界卫生组织的一位代表也将此称为流行病。

sentences.en: And I get this question a lot.
sentences.zh: 我经常听到这个问题。

sentences.en: And so I actually tried to look up the term epidemic to determine what the definition is and whether this met the criteria for that or not.
sentences.zh: 所以我特地查了一下“流行病”这个词，想弄清楚它的定义是什么，这种情况是否符合其标准。

sentences.en: And of course, most definitions out there refer to infectious diseases.
sentences.zh: 当然，现大多数定义指的都是传染病。

sentences.en: And so, of course, this doesn't apply in that sense.
sentences.zh: 因此，从这个意义上说，它当然不适用。

sentences.en: But yet, of course, we use the term about other kinds of health issues.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们当然也会把这个词用在其他类型健康问题上。

sentences.en: So for instance, it's been used to refer to as an obesity epidemic, an opioid epidemic.
sentences.zh: 比方说，它曾被用来形容肥胖流行病、阿片类药物流行病。

sentences.en: And so from a standpoint that this is something that is health relevant,
sentences.zh: 因此，从这是一个与健康相关的问题、

sentences.en: that affects a significant portion of the population, and something that is concerning that should be prioritized.
sentences.zh: 影响了相当大一部分人口、并且是一个令人担忧且应被优先对待的问题的角度来看，

sentences.en: I do believe the evidence does apply.
sentences.zh: 我确实相信这些证据是适用的。

sentences.en: There's some question about whether it is increasing or not.
sentences.zh: 关于这种情况是否在加剧，目前还存在一些疑问。

sentences.en: But we do have good evidence that a significant portion of the population is affected.
sentences.zh: 但我们确凿有据地证明，相当大一部分人口受到了影响。

sentences.en: So why do you think people are lonely today?
sentences.zh: 那你认为为什么现在的人会感到孤独呢？

sentences.en: I mean, you said you're not really quite sure if those numbers are increasing, or if it's just maybe we're becoming more aware of it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你刚才说过，你并不太确定这些数字是在增加，还是说也许只是我们对它的意识增强了。

sentences.en: But, you know, what are some of the reasons you're seeing why people are feeling lonely?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，你发现人们感到孤独的原因有哪些？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: Right.

sentences.en: And, and of course, I can only speculate in terms of why that is the case, because certainly, I and others have been studying these, this issue for some time.
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，我只能对为什么会这样进行推测，因为我和其他人研究这些问题已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: And so we've had data on this for a while.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这方面已经有了一段时间的数据。

sentences.en: But it seems to really only be widely acknowledged very recently.
sentences.zh: 但直到最近，它似乎才真正得到广泛认可。

sentences.en: And there seems to be some recent concern.
sentences.zh: 而且最近似乎也引起了一些关注。

sentences.en: And so, of course, even myself, I've thought about why it is that perhaps there is increasing attention.
sentences.zh: 因此，当然，连我自己也在思考，为什么这种关注度会不断提高。

sentences.en: And so, I mean, one possibility is that simply we now have more evidence.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，一种可能性是，我们现在拥有了更多的证据。

sentences.en: And so this is now simply getting acknowledged.
sentences.zh: 因此，这现在正逐渐得到认可。

sentences.en: But I do think that there may be more timely issues that may be contributing to increased awareness or increased concern.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，可能有一些更切时的问题促成了这种意识或担忧的增加。

sentences.en: And so, for instance, one possibility is that the way in which we interact socially has changed dramatically dramatically with changes in technology.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，一种可能性是，随着技术的发展，我们社交互动的方式已经发生了巨大的变化。

sentences.en: And of course, this is a hotly debated topic in terms of whether or not technology is increasing loneliness or not, or can be a solution or both.
sentences.zh: 当然，关于技术是否在加剧孤独、或者能否成为解决方案、亦或是兼而有之，这是一个争论激烈的话题。

sentences.en: But I do think that it is widely acknowledged that, that it has changed the way in which we interact socially.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，人们普遍承认，它确实改变了我们进行社会互动的方式。

sentences.en: And so, this has perhaps led to increased awareness and perhaps concern about the potential effects.
sentences.zh: 因此，这或许导致了人们对潜在影响的意识增强，甚至产生了担忧。

sentences.en: But it's probably not the only factor that may be leading to increased attention.
sentences.zh: 但这可能不是引起人们高度关注的唯一因素。

sentences.en: So, some other
sentences.zh: 所以，其他一些

sentences.en: potential explanations that, or hypotheses that have been offered, have been also, for instance,
sentences.zh: 人们提出的潜在解释或假设还有，比方说，

sentences.en: the divisive politics that we're seeing recently, not only in the US, but elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 我们最近看到的撕裂性政治，不仅在美国，在其他地方也是如此。

sentences.en: And this growing sense of a feeling of a fraying social fabric.
sentences.zh: 以及由此产生的社会纽带正在瓦解的渐进感。

sentences.en: And whether this has led to divisive politics or divisive politics have led to increased isolation from each other, increased isolation from each other and a feeling of isolation.
sentences.zh: 不管是这种现象导致了撕裂性的政治，还是撕裂性的政治导致了彼此间日益孤立、彼此疏离以及孤立感，

sentences.en: It's difficult to say.
sentences.zh: 这很难说。

sentences.en: But for instance, there was a, a Reuters poll, that showed that, that since the election, and I forget the exact
sentences.zh: 但举个例子，路透社曾做过一项民意调查，显示自大选以来——我记不清具体的

sentences.en: percentage, but that a significant portion of people have actually ended relationships with family and friends,
sentences.zh: 百分比了——相当一部分人实际上已经因为政治原因

sentences.en: over politics, over politics, and have, have unfollowed people on social media, over politics.
sentences.zh: 断绝了与家人和朋友的关系，并且在社交媒体上因为政治原因取消关注了其他人。

sentences.en: That's not surprising.
sentences.zh: 这并不令人意外。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's possible that that's playing a role.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这也有可能在其中发挥了作用。

sentences.en: We also know that there's changing demographics.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道人口结构正在发生变化。

sentences.en: And so, we have an increasing number of people who are living alone, more so now than ever.
sentences.zh: 因此，独居人口越来越多，比以往任何时候都要多。

sentences.en: And this is not just the case in the
sentences.zh: 不仅在美国是这样，

sentences.en: US, but also in the UK and Europe.
sentences.zh: 在英国和欧洲也是如此。

sentences.en: And we also have some evidence to suggest that network sizes are shrinking.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一些证据表明，社交圈的规模正在缩小。

sentences.en: We have fewer people who are getting married, fewer people that are having children.
sentences.zh: 结婚的人越来越少，生孩子的人也越来越少。

sentences.en: And so, with these changes in demographics, we also have increasing concern about how we're going to care for aging population that will
sentences.zh: 因此，随着人口结构的这些变化，人们也越来越担心我们将如何照顾日渐老化的人口，

sentences.en: have no longer have, or have less likely to have familial or community resources to draw upon in older age.
sentences.zh: 因为老年人将不再拥有、或更不可能在晚年依靠家庭或社区资源。

sentences.en: So, this might be another factor.
sentences.zh: 所以，这可能是另一个因素。

sentences.en: But, of course, we don't know the exact reason, and it's likely a number of factors that are contributing to it.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我们不知道确切的原因，这很可能是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sentences.en: Those may be potential factors that are at least leading to increase awareness and concern around this issue.
sentences.zh: 这些可能至少是引发人们对该问题意识和担忧增加的潜在因素。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's very interesting, as you mentioned, around the world, you know, we're reading of stories about,
sentences.zh: 是的，非常有趣，正如你所提到的，在世界各地，你知道，我们读到关于

sentences.en: you know, if you're talking about more older people, less younger people, there's a lot of changes in birth rates and things like that.
sentences.zh: 老年人增多、年轻人减少的故事，出生率发生了很多变化，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And also, how, you know, even if it's not social services, necessarily, or enough people in the workforce to take care of older people, it could
sentences.zh: 还有，无论是否必须依靠社会服务，或者是否有足够多的劳动力来照顾老年人，

sentences.en: also just be older, more older people, if they don't have other people, younger people, more younger people in their lives, they might be more lonely, too.
sentences.zh: 这也可能是因为，如果有更多老年人，而他们的生活中缺乏其他人、年轻人、更多的年轻人，他们也可能会感到更加孤独。

sentences.en: So, really, it's just interesting to see how it plays out over the years.
sentences.zh: 所以，看到这些现象多年来的演变，真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And one clarification I should make is, of course, just because someone lives alone or is unmarried or
sentences.zh: 我需要澄清的一点是，当然，一个人独居、未婚或

sentences.en: doesn't have children, doesn't necessarily mean that they are isolated or lonely.
sentences.zh: 没有孩子，并不一定意味着他们就与世隔绝或感到孤独。

sentences.en: So, you could, of course, have a wide social network and not feel lonely at all.
sentences.zh: 所以，你当然可以拥有广泛的社交网络，却一点也不感到孤独。

sentences.en: However, we do have some evidence that, for instance, living alone carries a significant risk for premature mortality independent of loneliness.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们确实有一些证据表明，例如，独居会带来显著的过早死亡风险，这与孤独感无关。

sentences.en: And there's some evidence to suggest that among those that live alone, they are more likely to report loneliness as well.
sentences.zh: 并且有一些证据表明，在独居人群中，他们也更有可能报告自己感到孤独。

sentences.en: Yeah, I wanted to elaborate on that a little bit, because I think sometimes people equate
sentences.zh: 是的，我想对这一点做点详细说明，因为我认为有时人们会把

sentences.en: someone who likes to spend time alone, maybe a more introverted person, they equate that with being lonely.
sentences.zh: 喜欢独处的人——也许是个更内向的人——等同于感到孤独。

sentences.en: But as you said, it's not really necessarily the case.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，情况并非必然如此。

sentences.en: I mean, some people like to spend, you know, go on, I know people like to go on vacations by themselves, you know, into the woods, you know, or whatnot.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些人喜欢花时间……我知道有人喜欢独自去度假，去树林里，或者诸如此类。

sentences.en: So, it's not necessarily the person's lonely, they just need their space and time alone from other people.
sentences.zh: 所以，这并不一定是说这个人很孤独，他们只是需要属于自己的空间和独处的时间，不受他人干扰。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: Right.

sentences.en: I think it is important to distinguish, because I think we, we often use the terms social isolation and loneliness interchangeably.
sentences.zh: 我认为进行区分是很重要的，因为我们经常把“社交孤立”和“孤独”这两个词混为一谈。

sentences.en: And of course, they can coexiSt. But they are independent.
sentences.zh: 当然，它们可以共存，但它们是相互独立的。

sentences.en: So, as you mentioned, you can be on your own, alone and not feel lonely.
sentences.zh: 因此，正如你所提到的，你可以自己一个人呆着，却不觉得孤独。

sentences.en: But of course, people can still feel lonely, even when surrounded by others.
sentences.zh: 但当然，即使身处人群环绕之中，人们依然会感到孤独。

sentences.en: So, it is important to, to recognize these distinctions,
sentences.zh: 因此，认清这些区别非常重要，

sentences.en: that they don't always go hand in hand, but they, they certainly can co, co-occur also.
sentences.zh: 它们并不总是齐头并进的，但它们当然也可能同时发生。

sentences.en: Yeah, I want to go back to what you mentioned about technology, because, you know, as most things in this world, there's a, it's a good thing and a blessing and a curse.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想回到你刚才提到关于技术的话题，因为，正如这个世界上的大多数事物一样，它既是一件好事、一种福气，也是一把双刃剑。

sentences.en: So, technology connects people with like minds from all over the world about various topics.
sentences.zh: 技术把全世界志同道合、关注各种话题的人连接在一起。

sentences.en: So, someone could say, I found someone who's interested in a very niche hobby that I'm into, where I might not have found someone in my community,
sentences.zh: 所以，有人可能会说，我找到了一个和我一样喜欢某种非常小众爱好的人，而在我所在的社区里我可能找不到这样的人，

sentences.en: and they might build an online community and feel really positive about that.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会建立一个网络社群，并对此感觉非常积极。

sentences.en: But others might feel disconnected from others, what, because they're communicating only through social media or text.
sentences.zh: 但其他人可能会觉得自己与他人失去了联系，因为他们只通过社交媒体或短信进行交流。

sentences.en: So, I wanted to ask if being connected electronically is a substitute for face-to-face connections at all.
sentences.zh: 所以我想问，电子连结能否完全替代面对面的连结？

sentences.en: So, that's, it's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: And I think we're still really trying to fully understand it.
sentences.zh: 我想我们仍在努力去完全理解它。

sentences.en: Because of course, technology can come in lots of different forMs. And, and I think we often, we often think of
sentences.zh: 因为技术的形式当然有很多种。而且，我们常常会想到

sentences.en: social media and Facebook, when we think of technology, but there are a variety, right?
sentences.zh: 社交媒体和脸书（Facebook），当我们想到技术时，但其实种类繁多，对吧？

sentences.en: But even among these kinds of uses, so the use of smartphones, or the use of social media,
sentences.zh: 但即使在这些使用方式中——比如智能手机的使用或社交媒体的使用，

sentences.en: even that the evidence is somewhat mixed in the sense of, we find different effects across age for,
sentences.zh: 即使在这方面，证据也有些参差不齐，因为我们发现不同年龄段的影响有所不同，

sentences.en: so for instance, there are some uses that show beneficial effects among older adults, but the same type of usage shows more detrimental effects among younger adults.
sentences.zh: 比如，有些使用方式对老年人显示出益处，但同类使用方式对年轻人却显示出更多的负面影响。

sentences.en: But depending on how you even use it shows different findings.
sentences.zh: 但甚至取决于你如何使用它，也会表现出不同的结果。

sentences.en: So, for instance, whether you are using it for communication versus passively, say, scrolling a news feed.
sentences.zh: 例如，你是用它来沟通，还是只是被动地浏览新闻动态。

sentences.en: But also, we have to keep in mind that much of the evidence that exists currently is cross-sectional or correlational.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们必须记住，目前存在的许多证据都是横断面研究或相关性研究。

sentences.en: And so, when we do find, for instance, a study that shows that people who spend more time online are more lonely, we can't say
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们发现某项研究显示花更多时间上网的人更孤独时，我们不能断言

sentences.en: that it's the time spent online that made them lonely, or whether people who are more lonely spend more time online.
sentences.zh: 是上网的时间让他们变得孤独，还是更孤独的人花了更多时间上网。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: Right.

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，确实如此。

sentences.en: It's not really clear cut in many ways.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这并不是非黑即白的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: Right.

sentences.en: And even those that, the studies that have followed people over time, these are typically very short-term follow-up.
sentences.zh: 甚至那些对人们进行长期追踪的研究，通常也只是非常短期的随访。

sentences.en: And so, we really currently lack the evidence to know what the long-term effects of these may be.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们目前确实缺乏证据来了解这些技术的长期影响可能是什么。

sentences.en: And so,
sentences.zh: 所以呢，

sentences.en: we do know, however, that there is robust evidence that being socially connected can have powerful influences on our health and well-being.
sentences.zh: 不过我们确实知道，有强有力的证据表明，保持社交连结会对我们的健康和福祉产生强大的影响。

sentences.en: So, to the extent to which this increases actual connection, so physical contact, or even a feeling of connection, is likely to be associated with more positive effects.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种连结在多大程度上增加了实际联系（即身体接触，甚至仅仅是连结感），就越有可能带来更多积极的影响。

sentences.en: And the extent to which these may detract or take away time from spending with others,
sentences.zh: 而如果这些东西分散或占用了与他人相处的时间，

sentences.en: or eliciting feelings of feeling more disconnected, this would likely have more detrimental effects.
sentences.zh: 或者引发了更加疏离的感觉，这就可能会产生更多有害的影响。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: Yeah.

sentences.en: So, what does the research say about why social relationships are important for our physical and mental health?
sentences.zh: 那么，研究对于为什么社交关系对我们的身心健康至关重要是怎么说的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: Yeah.

sentences.en: So, we have now decades of research that has examined this.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们已经进行了几十年的研究。

sentences.en: And in particular, my own research, we looked at the overall risk associated with lacking social connections on risk for premature mortality.
sentences.zh: 特别是我的研究，我们探讨了缺乏社交连结与过早死亡风险之间的总体风险。

sentences.en: And so, what we found was when we looked across a variety of ways of measuring social connections,
sentences.zh: 因此，我们发现，当我们综合考察多种衡量社交连结的方式时——

sentences.en: whether it be network size, or feelings of loneliness, or isolation, or social support,
sentences.zh: 无论是社交圈大小、孤独感、孤立感，还是社会支持，

sentences.en: averaged across these.

sentences.en: And keep in mind, we had 148 studies with over 300,000 participants.

sentences.en: And these followed people over time.

sentences.en: And to the extent that this was associated with a 50% increase in survival.
sentences.zh: 这种连结与生存率提高50%相关。

sentences.en: And just to put that into perspective, the magnitude of that effect is comparable,

sentences.en: and in some cases exceeds the other kinds of risk factors that we take very seriously for our health.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下甚至超过了我们对健康高度重视的其他风险因素。

sentences.en: So, for instance, this exceeds the risk associated with obesity, physical inactivity, and air pollution.
sentences.zh: 例如，这超过了与肥胖、缺乏身体锻炼和空气污染相关的风险。

sentences.en: So, those are the risk of lacking social connection.
sentences.zh: 这就是缺乏社交连结的风险。

sentences.en: And we've also looked specifically at indicators that look specifically at lack of social connection.
sentences.zh: 我们还专门研究了针对缺乏社交连结的具体指标。

sentences.en: So, social isolation, living alone, and loneliness.
sentences.zh: 即社会孤立、独居和孤独。

sentences.en: And in that meta-analysis, we had over 3.4 million participants.
sentences.zh: 在那项荟萃分析中，我们有超过340万名参与者。

sentences.en: And again, what we found was that each of these, even though they are conceptually distinct, each of these were significant predictors of premature mortality.
sentences.zh: 我们再次发现，尽管这些概念在定义上有所不同，但每一个都是预测过早死亡的重要指标。

sentences.en: So, we have, and keep in mind, there have been additional research that has been published since this time that has also found similar findings.
sentences.zh: 所以，请记住，自那以后还发表了其他研究，也得出了类似的结果。

sentences.en: So, we have very robust data that lacking social connections is a significant risk factor, and that being socially connected is a significant protective factor.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们拥有非常扎实的数据，证明缺乏社交连结是一个重大的危险因素，而保持社交连结是一个重大的保护因素。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's all very fascinating how important that is, not only in an individual's health and well-being,
sentences.zh: 是的，这非常引人入胜，它不仅对个人的健康和福祉至关重要，

sentences.en: but that well-being includes social connections and having others in our lives.

sentences.en: It's really powerful to show how necessary it is for our health and well-being.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: And whether that's through poor quality relationships, or a sense of lack on the part of our relationships that we cannot count on them.

sentences.en: And that when we are alone or with, compared to those, compared to when we are with others,

sentences.zh: 特别是与信任的人在一起时，例如，我们需要对环境中的威胁保持更高的警惕。

sentences.en: And so, this can have an effect on our bodies as our bodies are preparing to handle whatever threats they may be facing.

sentences.en: So, in this way, our relationships can have a powerful influence influence on our physiology that is very much related to the kinds of processes that occur when we are under

sentences.zh: 或者，正如我所提到的，也可能成为压力的来源。

sentences.zh: 因此，无论是由于非社交压力还是更多的社交相关压力，我们都可能会采取较差的健康行为。

sentences.zh: 无论是

sentences.zh: 当然，这是一个可能伴随着

sentences.zh: 社会转变的人生过渡期。

sentences.zh: 因此，问题在于这种情况一直如此，而我们现在只是看到了更多的证据，还是这一代青少年和

sentences.zh: 虽然我不知道我们是否能确定原因，但有几个假设

sentences.en: But it's certainly worth exploring further, given that we are seeing increases also of anxiety and depression on college campuses nationwide.

sentences.zh: 对于年轻一代来说，可能是从离开家到离家的过渡。

sentences.zh: 对于老一代来说，可能是从工作岗位向退休的过渡。

sentences.zh: 它也可能与其它种类的社会转变有关，例如孩子离家，

sentences.zh: 还有丧偶。

sentences.zh: 在老年人中，健康和行动不便问题带来的潜在影响

sentences.en: potentially have an influence.
sentences.zh: 也有所增加。

sentences.zh: 因此，随着健康问题的增加，这可能会降低一个人的社交能力。

sentences.en: So, what do you think about this?

sentences.zh: 如果老年人经历了配偶离世，如果他们正在生活、需要搬离

sentences.zh: 自己的家之类的地方，对我来说，搬到一个更小的地方或类似的地方，这是解决伴随老年人而来的孤独感的一种方案吗？

sentences.zh: 即使在某种可能有商店和餐馆的郊区，也是一种适合步行的区域，这与前几十年非常不同。

sentences.en: So, as you mentioned, I think it's really fascinating where urban design or, you know,
sentences.zh: 因此，正如你所提到的，我认为城市设计或，

sentences.en: community planning can really fit into creating a sense of community and how powerful that is.
sentences.zh: 社区规划如何真正融入营造社区感以及这有多么强大，这真的很迷人。

sentences.en: Because you can really feel the difference between an area that's where there's not a lot of people around, people really rely on their cars,
sentences.zh: 因为你真的能感受到周围没有多少人、人们真正依赖汽车的区域之间的区别，

sentences.en: it's not very friendly to people wanting to be out in that space,
sentences.zh: 它对想要在该空间中出行的人不太友好，

sentences.en: as opposed to an area where it really encourages walking and hanging out, that kind of thing, and encourages people to be out and being social with each other.
sentences.zh: 这与真正鼓励步行和闲逛等活动、并鼓励人们外出并彼此交往的区域形成了对比。

sentences.en: Do you have any more thoughts on that, about where we can go with urban planning and community design?
sentences.zh: 关于我们在城市规划和社区设计方面可以走向何方，你还有更多的想法吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, it's, it's really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，这，这真的很迷人。

sentences.en: I'm just, you know, as I mentioned, I think we often think about solutions from this individual perspective.
sentences.zh: 我只是，你知道的，正如我所提到的，我认为我们经常从这种个人的角度考虑解决方案。

sentences.en: And yet, we really need to think about it from the more of a community and even population wide level types of solutions.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们真的需要从更多社区甚至全人口范围的解决方案类型的角度来思考它。

sentences.en: And as we think about how we design our communities, not only do we need to think about, you know, how walkable it is, but how that impacts people socially.
sentences.zh: 当我们考虑如何设计我们的社区时，我们不仅需要考虑它的步行友好程度，还要考虑这如何对人们产生社交影响。

sentences.en: And there is, the World Health Organization has a health in all policy framework.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织有一个“健康融入所有政策”（health in all policy）的框架。

sentences.en: And if you think about how there are health implications for policy to policy and practices, I think we could extend that to social in all policy in the sense of,
sentences.zh: 如果你想想政策到政策和实践如何产生健康影响，我认为我们可以将其扩展到“社交融入所有政策”，即

sentences.en: what are the social implications of, what are the social implications of, of policy and practices, including things like urban design and transportation.
sentences.zh: 政策和实践的社会影响是什么，包括城市设计和交通等事情。

sentences.en: I think most of us don't readily connect transportation as being a social issue,
sentences.zh: 我想我们大多数人不会轻易把交通联系成一个社会问题，

sentences.en: but whether it is impeding one's ability to get around and get out, certainly for older adults, or those with mobility issues, this can be incredibly isolating.
sentences.zh: 但无论是它阻碍了一个人四处走动和出门的能力，对老年人或行动不便的人来说，这无疑会带来难以置信的孤立感。

sentences.en: But also just to how inviting and welcoming a community is, or even a sense of, of feeling safe and secure.
sentences.zh: 而且这也关乎一个社区的诱人程度和热情程度，甚至关乎安全感。

sentences.en: So, for instance, communities that, where there are safety concerns, people are less likely to be out in their community, less opportunity to engage with others,
sentences.zh: 例如，存在安全隐患的社区，人们不太可能外出融入社区，与他人交往的机会也更少，

sentences.en: and this can lead to greater isolation as well.
sentences.zh: 这也会导致更严重的孤立。

sentences.en: So, everything from the safety of the community, to just having spaces to gather, to even how well it's maintained.
sentences.zh: 因此，从社区的安全，到拥有聚会的空间，再到维护得有多好，一切皆是如此。

sentences.en: So, uneven sidewalks can be a problem for people getting out and interacting with others.
sentences.zh: 因此，不平坦的人行道可能是人们外出与他人互动的一个问题。

sentences.en: So, just as, as another anecdote, I, when I was in one of these Blue Zones, I met a 105-year-old man.
sentences.zh: 因此，就像另一个轶事一样，我在其中一个蓝色地带时，遇到了一位105岁的老人。

sentences.en: And, and the, the first time I met him, he had been riding his bike, I think, 15 kilometers every single day.
sentences.zh: 而且，我第一次见到他时，他好像每天都在骑自行车，骑15公里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, and so, not only was I incredibly impressed that he's riding a bike at 105, but that what I was impressed with is not only just the, of course,
sentences.zh: 因此，不仅他对105岁还在骑自行车这一点让我印象深刻，而且让我印象深刻的不仅仅是，当然，

sentences.en: the physical health benefits of being physically active, but he was incredibly involved in his community.
sentences.zh: 身体活跃带来的身体健康益处，而是他非常积极地参与社区活动。

sentences.en: So, he was, so he was able to get out to the shops, he visited other people in the community, he was involved in the theater, he was, he was out and about in the community,
sentences.zh: 因此，他能够外出购物，探访社区中的其他人，他参与戏剧活动，他在社区里到处走动，

sentences.en: he wasn't waiting for others to come visit him.
sentences.zh: 他并没有等待别人来探望他。

sentences.en: And, and so, when we think about transportation and mobility, we do need to think about the, the social consequences that are related to these.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们考虑交通和出行时，我们确实需要考虑与这些相关的社会后果。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, that's fascinating and shows the importance of also putting yourself out there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这很迷人，也表明了展现自我的重要性。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a two-way street.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是双向的。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, you don't, sometimes, maybe people are more shy or reserved, but, you know, the importance of trying things and, you know, seeking out others with like interests,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道的，你不会，有时，也许人们更害羞或内向，但是，你知道，尝试新事物以及寻找志同道合的人的重要性，

sentences.en: that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Yeah, you've spoken a lot about the trends you're seeing globally.
sentences.zh: 是的，你谈到了很多你在全球范围内看到的趋势。

sentences.en: And I know you were a recent keynote speaker of the UK campaign to end loneliness.
sentences.zh: 我知道你最近是英国终结孤独运动的主旨发言人。

sentences.en: And I read another article about how Britain has recently appointed a minister of loneliness.
sentences.zh: 我读了另一篇文章，关于英国最近如何任命了一位孤独大臣。

sentences.en: So, can you talk more about what conversations people around the world are having about loneliness and how to combat loneliness?
sentences.zh: 那么，你能多谈谈世界各地的人们在讨论关于孤独的什么话题，以及如何对抗孤独吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: So, not only did they, did the UK appoint a minister for loneliness, but they recently published a national health strategy around loneliness,
sentences.zh: 因此，英国不仅任命了一位孤独大臣，他们最近还围绕孤独发布了一项国家健康战略，

sentences.en: which has really outlines a strategic plan for addressing this at a national level, from assessment to
sentences.zh: 这确实概述了一个在国家层面上解决这一问题的战略计划，从评估到

sentences.en: multiple departments addressing this.
sentences.zh: 多个部门来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: I also have been to Australia.
sentences.zh: 我也去过澳大利亚。

sentences.en: I also have been to Australia.
sentences.zh: 我也去过澳大利亚。

sentences.en: I'm on the Australian Coalition to End Loneliness.
sentences.zh: 我是澳大利亚终结孤独联盟的成员。

sentences.en: I'm on their scientific advisory board.
sentences.zh: 我是他们科学顾问委员会的成员。

sentences.en: And they have multiple organizations in Australia that are also devoted to this.
sentences.zh: 他们在澳大利亚有多个组织也致力于此。

sentences.en: So, they have a national organization called Relationships Australia.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们有一个名为“澳大利亚人际关系”（Relationships Australia）的国家组织。

sentences.en: Australia.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚。

sentences.en: We also know that many countries in Europe, I was recently in Madrid, Spain, and where there were people not only from Spain talking about their efforts, but from other nations,
sentences.zh: 我们也知道欧洲的许多国家，我最近去了西班牙马德里，那里不仅有来自西班牙的人在谈论他们的努力，还有来自其他国家的人，

sentences.en: including Denmark and Germany and other countries.
sentences.zh: 包括丹麦、德国和其他国家。

sentences.en: And so, we do know that many of these other countries are looking into this at a national level.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们确实知道许多其他国家正在国家层面研究这个问题。

sentences.en: And the UK is, from my awareness, leading the way in terms of having a very strategic plan in place
sentences.zh: 据我所知，英国在制定非常具有战略性的计划方面走在前列，

sentences.en: and an appointed government position to oversee this work.
sentences.zh: 并且任命了专门的政府职位来监督这项工作。

sentences.en: That's not to say that we aren't doing anything in the US.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我们在美国什么都没做。

sentences.en: There are many organizations here in the US that are highly interested in this and are addressing this.
sentences.zh: 美国有许多组织对这个课题高度关注并正在着手解决。

sentences.en: But certainly, we have a long way to go to address this very complex issue.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，要解决这个非常复杂的问题，我们还有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's fascinating because I think it's easy to assume that this could be maybe an American problem because of an emphasis on an individuality.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得这很迷人，因为人们很容易认为这可能是一个美国问题，因为我们强调个人主义。

sentences.en: But it's fascinating to know that it's across the board in other countries where, you know, that might have some aspects of traditional life, like you said,
sentences.zh: 但令人着迷的是，这种情况在其他国家也普遍存在，正如你所说，这些国家可能保留了某些传统生活的方面，

sentences.en: in Spain or things like that.
sentences.zh: 比如西班牙或类似的地方。

sentences.en: But, you know, perhaps this is just something that comes along with maybe some aspects of modern life, maybe some more awareness.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，也许这只是现代生活某些方面带来的伴随现象，或者是伴随着更高的意识。

sentences.en: But yeah, it sounds like there's just a lot of really positive things happening in this in this space or in all different countries.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，听起来在这个领域或在所有不同的国家里，正在发生许多非常积极的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so, I'm just excited to watch how this unfolds and and importantly,
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴能关注这一切将如何展开，而且重要的是，

sentences.en: so that we can look to the kinds of solutions that are effective and how can we do them even more efficiently and more effectively.
sentences.zh: 我们可以寻找有效的解决方案，以及如何能做得更加高效和有效。

sentences.en: Is there any research about how pets can help with loneliness?
sentences.zh: 有没有关于宠物如何帮助缓解孤独的研究？

sentences.en: The American Veterinary Medical Association says that pet ownership is on the rise.
sentences.zh: 美国兽医协会表示，宠物饲养率正在上升。

sentences.en: Do you know if that has anything to do with people feeling more lonely?
sentences.zh: 你知道这是否与人们感到更加孤独有关吗？

sentences.en: So, first off, I should mention that when we looked at the effects of being socially connected on on longevity, we limited it to studies that were human based.
sentences.zh: 首先，我应该提到，当我们研究社会联系对寿命的影响时，我们将其限制在以人类为基础的研究上。

sentences.en: But certainly, many people see their pets as a source of support and comfort.
sentences.zh: 但当然，许多人将宠物视为支持和慰藉的来源。

sentences.en: And so, but there is some evidence to suggest that pet ownership and in particular dog ownership may be associated with better outcomes.
sentences.zh: 因此，确实有一些证据表明，养宠物，特别是养狗，可能与更好的结果相关。

sentences.en: I'm less familiar with the details of the strength of that evidence, but I am aware that there is some evidence to suggest that pet ownership is associated with some benefits.
sentences.zh: 我对该证据强度的具体细节了解较少，但我知道确实有一些证据表明养宠物带来了一些益处。

sentences.en: And, and, and of course, you know, there's, whether it is that pets are a source of comfort and social support, or whether it is that having something or someone that,
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道，无论是宠物作为安慰和社交支持的来源，还是拥有某种东西或某人，

sentences.en: that relies upon you so that there's meaning and purpose,
sentences.zh: 他们依赖你，从而带来意义和目标感，

sentences.en: or whether it's, or whether it's the physical activity of having to say, for instance, walk a dog, or if it's that activity that gets you out interacting with other people, there,
sentences.zh: 或者是因为不得不做某事而带来的体力活动，比如遛狗，或者这种活动让你走出去与其他人互动，

sentences.en: those are some, you know, potential explanations.
sentences.zh: 这些都是一些潜在的解释。

sentences.en: But of course, I, I'm less familiar with this work than I am with the human research.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我对这方面的研究不如对人类研究那么熟悉。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's maybe perhaps there's some, like I said, anecdotal things, or, you know, you know, if people want a pet, it doesn't hurt to have someone who is a comforting,
sentences.zh: 是的，也许正如我所说，有一些轶事般的说法，或者你知道的，如果人们想要一只宠物，家里有一个能够提供慰藉、

sentences.en: cuddly animal around the house, or active animal around the house, depending on what kind of pet you have.
sentences.zh: 招人喜爱的动物在身边并没有坏处，或者是根据你养的宠物种类，是一个活跃的动物在身边。

sentences.en: It's just as we wrap up here, I wanted to know if you have any advice for people who are feeling lonely.
sentences.zh: 在我们的访谈接近尾声时，我想知道你对感到孤独的人有什么建议。

sentences.en: I mean, is, do you have anything that you can share to people who might be feeling this way?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你有什么可以分享给那些可能有这种感受的人吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so, of course, from a scientific standpoint, we're still trying to really identify what are the best approaches to reducing loneliness.
sentences.zh: 好的，从科学的角度来看，我们仍在努力确定减少孤独感的最佳方法是什么。

sentences.en: And I think the biggest challenge is going to be the fact that for different people, what's causing that loneliness may be very different.
sentences.zh: 我认为最大的挑战在于，对于不同的人来说，导致孤独的原因可能截然不同。

sentences.en: And so, the, the way in which that loneliness might reduce might mean a very different approach for one person than for another.
sentences.zh: 因此，减轻这种孤独感的方式可能意味着对一个人和另一个人采取非常不同的方法。

sentences.en: However, and it's, there has been surveys that have asked people, when you've been lonely in the past, what has helped and what has not been helpful?
sentences.zh: 然而，有一些调查曾询问人们：当你过去感到孤独时，什么是有帮助的，什么是没有帮助的？

sentences.en: And so, for instance, the recent BBC survey asked this,
sentences.zh: 例如，最近的BBC调查就问了这个问题，

sentences.en: and what I found so fascinating about it was that one of the top responses for what has been helpful was getting involved in social groups.
sentences.zh: 让我觉得最着迷的是，被认为有帮助的最高票回答之一就是参与社交群体。

sentences.en: But it was also one of the top responses for advice that was given to them that was not helpful.
sentences.zh: 但它也是给他们的建议中被认为没有帮助的最高票回答之一。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like, speak to what's the individual person's needs.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就像是针对每个人的具体需求发言。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so, that might be that it may be helpful for some and not for others, but it also might be that it might be that the right kind of social group might be helpful,
sentences.zh: 所以，这可能对某些人有用，对其他人没用；但也可能是因为，某种正确的社交群体可能会有帮助，

sentences.en: but not all social groups might be helpful.
sentences.zh: 并非所有的社交群体都有用。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: You definitely have to build connections with people.
sentences.zh: 你绝对必须与人建立联系。

sentences.en: I mean, just being around others who, you know, might not be the same as when you have deep connections with people and can really, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，仅仅和他人在一起，你知道，这可能与你和别人有深厚联系、并且真正能够，你知道的，

sentences.en: be intimate with someone on either a friendship or a romantic relationship level.
sentences.zh: 在友谊或浪漫关系层面上与某人保持亲密关系是不同的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so, you know, one thing that might be incredibly challenging and difficult to do for some, though, is to reach out to other people.
sentences.zh: 因此，对某些人来说，极其具有挑战性和困难的一件事，就是向他人伸出援手。

sentences.en: And so, there's some evidence to suggest that providing support to others can actually be more beneficial than receiving support.
sentences.zh: 有一些证据表明，向他人提供支持实际上可能比接受支持更有益。

sentences.en: And so, instead of perhaps waiting for others to help you or to reach out to you, find ways that you can help others and reach out to others.
sentences.zh: 因此，与其等着别人来帮助你或联系你，不如寻找能够帮助他人和联系他人的方法。

sentences.en: Well, this has been a fascinating conversation.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一次迷人的对话。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢你加入我们，霍尔特-伦斯塔德博士。

sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。
